audit_kind: independent source, interface and edge-case verification

checked: Exact component identifier set and component types, independently decoded from untouched original MLAPP
Static UI text, tab titles and dropdown items
Grid rows, columns, spans, spacing and padding
All 37 plot titles, x axis labels and y axis labels

edge_cases: NPC omitted only at (0,0); positive/negative and single-zero coordinates remain visible
NPC heading vector, magenta x marker and 0.3 scale on main/planning trajectories
Partially absent NPC group does not break remaining plots
CSV command columns preserve file order, excluding prefix/suffix lookalikes
Single-row and final-row data with prediction horizons 1, 2, 10 and 30 across all 37 plots
Duplicate timestamps preserve infinite derivatives and NaN rather than inventing numeric values
Missing/noncontiguous lap IDs and nonfinite lap rows
Nearest-distance tie selects first row, consistent with MATLAB min
Initial NaN/Inf timestamp rejected with DataError
Successful reload restores default pit visibility
Selecting absent lap restores GUI selector to actual lap without moving data index
Track/engine resources load using SciPy/Pandas; runtime source imports no MATLAB and calls no external MATLAB process

findings_fixed_during_audit.issue: Pit visibility persisted across loads unlike original read_data_file default
findings_fixed_during_audit.resolution: Successful load resets state.pit to true; regression passes

findings_fixed_during_audit.issue: Selecting nonexistent lap desynchronized selector and displayed data
findings_fixed_during_audit.resolution: Restore selector and show error without clearing it; regression passes

runtime_environment.finding: Inherited LD_LIBRARY_PATH prioritizes system Qt6 over PySide6 bundled libraries, causing Qt6DBus undefined symbol
runtime_environment.verified_workaround: run_analyzer.py prefers bundled Qt and project-local X11 support libraries; native xcb smoke test passed

original_behavior_notes: Source references Tab_GGV_hw and plot_ggv_hw but creates no such tab or axis; this is dead code, not a missing visible page
Yaw and yaw-error curve samples retain raw values under the original deg labels; info yaw_error is converted to degrees
Displayed ms is the original rounded fractional second without multiplying by 1000
Prediction time/value vectors are jointly truncated near EOF to fix the original dimension mismatch
Missing optional data are displayed as unavailable instead of propagating original stale-array/index failures
View-size selection takes effect after initial render; original saved-limit behavior could ignore it
limits: This independent audit does not claim exhaustive equivalence for every possible CSV
Qt/Matplotlib is not a pixel-identical MATLAB renderer; all 24 recorded quiver scale factors have now passed numerical verification, but arrow-head shape and antialiasing differ
Numeric MATLAB-oracle comparison is recorded separately in parity_report.json
Final full regression suite passes without warnings; see REPORT.md for the tested environment
